SUSMITHA

Phone :

E-mail : susmithadata25@gmail.com

OBJECTIVE

Results-driven BI & Data Analyst/Data Engineer with over 4 years of experience in cloud-based data processing, designing and optimizing data pipelines across cloud platforms. Seeking to leverage strong analytical skills and hands-on experience in ETL processes, data visualization, and cloud technologies to drive data-driven decision- making and enhance business performance in a dynamic organization.

EXPERIENCE SUMMARY

Created interactive data visualizations and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, and Qliksense, driving insights and improving decision-making for stakeholders.

Experienced in cloud-based data processing, business intelligence and Direct-To-Consumer(D2C) analytics.

Proficient in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BIG Query and BI tools.

Experienced BI & Data Analyst, Data Engineer proficient in designing and optimizing data pipelines across GCP & Azure.

Expertise in ETL/ELT processes, data migration, and data warehousing using tools like Azure Data Factory, Databricks and Snowflake.

Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL (T-SQL, PL/SQL), PySpark and Apache Spark for data processing and transformation.

Extensive knowledge in data modeling, data governance, and managing large-scale datasets in data lakes and data warehouses.

Strong Analytical mindset with a keen eye for data accuracy, trends, and insights that drive business growth.

Reduced data processing times by 40% through optimization of data storage and retrieval processes, including Parquet and Delta Lake.

Skilled in integrating data from on-premises and cloud environments, ensuring seamless data ingestion and real-time processing with  Azure Synapse Analytics and Apache Kafka.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals.

Strong experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban), contributing to sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand-ups.

Skills

GCP BigQuery | Azure Databricks  | Azure Gen2/Blob Storage | S3 | Python | Azure Data Factory | Snowflake | Azure SQL DB | Azure Synapse Analytics | Google Cloud Dataflow | PySpark

| Apache Spark | Spark-SQL | SQL Server | PostgreSQL | Airflow | Talend | Informatica | CI/CD Pipelines | Data Ingestion | Data Migration | ETL | ELT | Data Lake | Data Warehouse | Data Modeling | Data Governance | Power BI | Data Visualization  | Tableau | Looker | SSIS | SSRS | SSMS | RDBMS | T-SQL | PL/SQL | Agile Methodology | UNIX | Shell Scripting | Apache Kafka | AWS Athena | AWS EMR | Azure DevOps | Git | GitHub | Power Automate | Real-time Data Processing

WORK EXPERIENCE

Employer:	CLOUDFIRST TECHNOLOGIES LTD

Client:	Santander UK plc

Role:	BI & Data Analyst

Period:	Aug 2022 – Till date.

Responsibilities:

Developed tailored Power BI/Tableau dashboards to visualize complex datasets, improving decision-making processes for financial, sales, and operational departments.

Analyzed large datasets using GCP & BigQuery to derive business insights for D2C initiatives, marketing campaigns and customer behaviors.

Designed and implemented data models using DAX and Power Query, optimizing data retrieval for reporting and reducing report generation time by 30%.

Provided ad-hoc reporting and data analysis to cross-functional teams, supporting key business decisions and optimizing day-to-day operations.

Conducted in-depth statistical analysis on sales and performance data using Python and SQL, providing insights that boosted sales productivity by 15%.

Collaborated with stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical solutions, ensuring alignment between data strategy and business objectives.

Implemented automated Power BI report refreshes using Power Automate and scheduled triggers, cutting down manual reporting efforts by 50%.

Ensured data security by applying role-based access controls within Power BI, maintaining compliance with data governance policies.

Worked closely with Developers to optimize the data layer, ensuring accurate web tracking and event-based data collection.

Leveraged data analytics to detect market trends and customer behavior, supporting marketing and sales teams in formulating data-driven strategies.

Integrated multiple data sources such as SQL, Excel, and cloud platforms into cohesive Power BI dashboards, enabling real-time insights for key stakeholders.

Spearheaded the migration from Excel-based reports to Power BI, reducing manual work by 60% and enhancing report accuracy.

Enhanced data quality through advanced data cleansing, validation, and transformation processes, reducing errors by 20% across reports.

Created dynamic visualizations in Power BI using features like bookmarks, drill-through, and tooltips to provide users with a better interactive experience.

Improved database performance by indexing and efficiently querying large datasets, which resulted in a 25% reduction in report loading times.

Utilized machine learning algorithms to forecast sales trends and predict customer behavior, providing actionable insights for decision-makers.

Employer:	GBS Technology Solutions Ltd

Client:            Admiral Group Plc

Role:               Data Engineer

Period:	Sep 2020 – Jul 2022

Responsibilities:

Developed and implemented end-to-end data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks, enabling the integration of structured and unstructured data sources, improving data accessibility by 35%.

Streamlined ETL processes using PySpark and Spark SQL, leading to a 50% reduction in data processing time and optimizing workflows for faster insights.

Designed data architectures leveraging Azure Data Lake and Delta Lake, ensuring scalable storage solutions for large datasets, which enhanced data retrieval speeds by 40%.

Migrated on-premises data to the Azure cloud platform, using ADF pipelines to automate data ingestion and transformation, reducing migration time by 30%.

Built reusable PySpark libraries for data transformation tasks, reducing development time by 20% and ensuring consistency in code standards.

Implemented continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines with Azure DevOps, improving code deployment efficiency and reducing release times by 50%.

Created and maintained version control using Git and Azure Repos, ensuring seamless collaboration among data engineers and reducing conflicts during the development lifecycle.

Developed data validation and monitoring frameworks to ensure the integrity and quality of data pipelines, catching and resolving errors before they impacted downstream systems.

Worked closely with data scientists and analysts to ensure data pipelines delivered accurate, high- quality datasets for machine learning models and business reporting.

Built dynamic data integration pipelines that ingest real-time data from multiple sources, enhancing the capability for near-instant business insights and reporting.

Optimized storage and retrieval using distributed file systems like Parquet and Delta formats in Azure Databricks, reducing storage costs by 25% while improving query performance.

Led the design and implementation of Azure Synapse Analytics solutions, increasing scalability and improving data querying times for large datasets by 30%.

Implemented error-handling mechanisms and logging frameworks to capture pipeline failures, reducing debugging time and increasing data pipeline reliability.

Orchestrated data pipelines to support both batch and streaming data workflows, providing flexibility in processing real-time and historical data.

Reduced cloud resource costs by 20% through the optimization of data flow architecture and efficient use of Azure cloud services.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance data solutions that meet business requirements and align with best practices in data engineering.

Participated in Agile methodologies like Scrum, actively contributing to sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand-ups to ensure timely delivery of data engineering projects.

Provided technical leadership on data migration projects, offering expertise in data integration, architecture, and security for smooth transitions to the cloud.

Spearheaded efforts to document ETL workflows and data pipeline architecture, enabling easier knowledge transfer and reducing onboarding time for new team members.

Education

Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science.

STRENGTHS

A Team Player with excellent interpersonal communication skills. Able to adapt all challenges.

Self-motivated, determined and Responsible towards tasks and duties.

Smart worker, Organized and Efficient which contributes to make me a Good Team Player.

Certifications

PL-300 Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate

DP-203 Data Engineering on Azure
